scope: Final frozen source independent code/math/declared-approximation review. Existing exact affine-limit, Jacobian, immutable record, same-method full K-record tests and independent previous downstream probe are cross-referenced; no production/tests edits and no new physical run.

checks.details: Freeze m,P and covariance-support L once; candidate z=m+L xi; objective .5||xi||²+.5||C_R^-1 r||². Repeated optimizer iterations neither replace the prior nor multiply the observation again.

Recover original image-Hessian full 6x6 Schur Gaussian. Keep each original native mode/normalized log mass, fixed R_k and covariance. Residual is [t_CM-t_k; Log(R_k.T R_CM)] and derivative [J_t; Jr^-1 residualrot J_right]. No parent-specific observation chart or extra point-dependent chart-volume factor.

checks.topic: IMU fixed S2 angular scalar likelihood
checks.details: Observed b and B are fixed. r=(atan2(||B.T d||,b.T d)/||B.T d||) B.T d, covariance sigma² I2, derivative chained through finite inverse-path orientation. Small-angle series evaluates the removable limit; heading adds no observation. Exact antipodal direction is a genuine Log-derivative cut, near-antipodal finite candidates are retained.

Whiten with the observation Cholesky lower factor, not its transpose. A=C_R^-1 J L, M=I+A.T A. Return Pplus=L M^-1 L.T including every joint/body/environment cross block and original Dirac support. No diagonalization of the result, jitter or covariance clip.

logZhat=-Phi(xihat)-.5logdetR-.5logdetM-.5dlog(2pi). Prior support determinant and (2pi)^(r/2) cancel under whitening. Preserve separate evidence parts before adding native and parent log weights, normalize globally over all declared parent/native combinations. Float underflow does not delete finite-log branches.

Keep finite accepted iterate on work budget or line-search exhaustion; record score/stationarity and actual trial errors. No convergence score gate. An actually nonfinite initial/final evaluation, invalid proper observation covariance, or required matrix factorization failure still raises; no synthetic evidence/covariance/old-method replacement.

Frozen original joint priors/branch IDs persist separately from reexpressed actual posteriors; sensor views are actual posterior push-forwards and are not re-lifted. Iteration records frozen once. Existing full within/between projection creates the canonical law used by K numerator, control/display, next prior and fresh-goal camera. Original acquisition q/t/ID stay attached.

Affine reference is an explicit configured comparison method only. identity_run is called with an empty observation list for result scaffold/identity, never as a failure fallback. Nonlinear exceptions are not caught and replaced with affine updates.
Only simultaneous likelihood IDs supplied in one run call are canonicalized; the outside chronological per-event loop is unchanged. Immediate duplicate ID is identity; older consumed IDs need replay.

measurement_and_approximation_limits: The finite modal embedding is the Bingham-derived local Gaussian proxy pushed through t=tref+delta_t,q=qref*rvq(delta_r); it is not exact global Bingham nonlinear conditioning.

Image fixed-chart normalized Gaussian is a declared scalar likelihood proxy, not the raw-pixel likelihood or a globally normalized Haar pose density. IMU fixed S2 Log Gaussian is likewise a scalar angular proxy, not an asserted globally normalized S2 density.

Posterior covariance is Gauss-Newton, not the exact nonlinear Hessian inverse or exact posterior moment. One finite proxy per explicit prior/native branch does not enumerate all nonlinear posterior modes.

At a finite nonstationary iterate the reported GN-Laplace value is not the exact integral of the tangent quadratic: no .5 g.T M^-1 g completed-square correction is included. Logs explicitly disclose finite_nonstationary_iterate_used/exact_nonlinear_evidence_claimed=False; do not call it exact evidence or a verified global MAP.

evaluator_calls counts successfully completed evaluations only. Failed trial calls are represented separately in line_search.actual_trial_error. completed_iterations counts attempted outer iterations, including a final unsuccessful line search.
No new runtime, throughput, reaching, estimation accuracy or jump-resolution claim is established by this read-only review. New 90-second runs must be assessed on their own source-frozen records.
